input.summary: Extend licence to Client affiliates on written notice and permit transfer to a successor in an M&A transaction.
input.comment: [Playbook] We need the licence to reach our affiliates on written notice and to travel to a successor in a merger or acquisition, so we have added affiliates to the grant and carved successor transfers out of the consent requirement. This is our fallback position on licence scope.

ops.oldText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business
ops.newText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client, and to its affiliates upon written notice to TrueLink, a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business

ops.oldText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate or to a successor in a merger or acquisition transaction.
